crossRefs.note: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs…
Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses…
The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
Let all things be done decently and in order.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.
translations.bsb: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
translations.kjv: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
translations.asv: Then the tent of meeting shall set forward, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place, by their standards.
